attributes_unit.source: 7-8B Llama-3.1-8B: A1's attributes pass (the engine's attributes job, kind attributes, split dev, checkpoints q and e1) on the family's a0-1101 retrain under recipe S_78 with the family's anchor file (Part 1 section 3.7, section 14 items 1-2); its COMPLETE.json and the retrain's, pinned here by the lead after the pass; the 1B value was Gate B's wave-0b unit

a1.bi_anchored_sign: bi_anchored = the harmful-anchor aggregate minus the safe-anchor aggregate, per variant; positive: a small descent step on the group's rows lowers the harmful anchors' mean response loss more than the safe anchors' to first order (the rows support unsafe over safe responses); local, noncausal, not a removal estimate
a1.category_flag_rule: if at least 50% of the selected rows are one category, A1 is also compared with that category's Gate B unit arm (PLAN-S:149)

consistency.rule: for each unit, the mean of its rows' a_i must equal groups.json groups.<unit>.bi_anchored.checkpoint_gradsim within abs_tolerance (absolute), or the writer refuses

a1.edit_name: stage-1 A1: remove the 600 training rows with the largest bi-anchored checkpoint GradSim score a_i (Gate C's attribution method, per row, at Llama-3.1-8B a0-1101's q and e1 (S_78 retrain))
a1.orientation: descending: remove the largest a_i. Positive a_i: a small descent step on the row lowers the harmful anchors' mean response loss more than the safe anchors' (BI_ANCHORED_SIGN)
a1.requirement: REQ-14 (brief rev 1 12cbf463; AUDIT closure 2; lead decisions b8a67719 L1)
a1.rule: a_i = the mean over the checkpoints [q, e1] of (the row's cosine to the harmful anchor set's mean gradient minus its cosine to the safe anchor set's mean gradient), read from the wave-0b attributes unit's rows.jsonl (variant checkpoint_gradsim; the Adam variant and every other field are never used); remove the 600 rows with the largest a_i over all 4,800 training rows (global, not per unit); ties by the sealed rank of registry key a1.ties over all training row ids

family_78b.engine_rule: PP4 (the lead's ruling, 5 Nov 2026): every wrapper kind runs on engine X (engine_x above): untuned_answers, rep_pass, l1_scan and classifier on the pod; l1_score, s3_score, score_edit, add_edit and s_pool on the Mac. Every derived settings file carries engine_x unchanged from the 1B file, and the frozen check_settings refuses another engine identity (R: scripts/stage1/s1common.py:590-592). A run on engine Y needs the settings re-derived for Y (engine_x = Y's identity, a new PINS-78B.json, a new PINS_FILE_SHA256) by a recorded step; none exists. The engine's own jobs (the a0-1101 retrain, a1_pass) follow ruling 10 and addendum A13, not this rule. The kit packs scorer pods with engine X.
family_78b.kind_names: PP3: rep_pass is REQ-3's representation pass (scripts/stage1/representation_pass.py; the stage-1 kit's name; this layer's rep_pass kind); a1_pass is A1's attributes pass on the a0-1101 retrain's q and e1 states (the engine's attributes job; RP:43's 6-11 h; the 16.5 h cap at most; its consumer here is score_edit a1). Each has its own E cap; both need S_78 and the anchor file. rules_78b.py and Part 2 use these names. Copied into representation_pass__<family>.json and write_score_edit__<family>.json family_78b.kind_names.
family_78b.rule: the 1B file's schema and name, so scripts/stage1's unchanged check_settings accepts it; every value that differs from the 1B file is per family (pins_78b.json) or a documented 7-8B rule; a null is a pin that waits for the event named in waits; scorers_78b.py refuses a command while a pin it needs is null

a1.attributes_unit.code_sha256.event: the engine that trains the family's a0-1101 states and runs A1's pass on them: X (472fc7f6...) or Y after the family's certificate (Part 1 section 3.7, EM-1; EYD:81); the lead fills it from the pass's COMPLETE.json by a recorded step

a1.attributes_unit.complete_sha256.event: the Llama-3.1-8B a0-1101 retrain under S_78 (Part 1 section 3.7), then A1's attributes pass on its q and e1 states with the family's anchor file (the engine's attributes job; the stage-1 kit's a1_rescore form): the pass's COMPLETE.json SHA-256 and the retrain's

a1.attributes_unit.query_bank.event: the Llama-3.1-8B anchor job (scripts/make_anchor_answers.py on the family's main recipe, single-job pod, KD6): anchors.sealed.json 'anchor_file_sha256' of its committed record

a1.attributes_unit.query_bank_sha256.event: the Llama-3.1-8B anchor job (scripts/make_anchor_answers.py on the family's main recipe, single-job pod, KD6): anchors.sealed.json 'anchor_file_sha256' of its committed record

a1.attributes_unit.recipe_sha256.event: the Llama-3.1-8B anchor job, then scripts/scale78b/make_recipe_s78.py --family llama31-8b --anchors-sha256 <anchor_file_sha256>, then the lead's commit by explicit path (addendum A1, A2); the same value as runkit/stage1-78b/rules_78b.py RECIPE_S['llama31-8b']

a1.attributes_unit.retrain_complete_sha2.event: the Llama-3.1-8B a0-1101 retrain under S_78 (Part 1 section 3.7), then A1's attributes pass on its q and e1 states with the family's anchor file (the engine's attributes job; the stage-1 kit's a1_rescore form): the pass's COMPLETE.json SHA-256 and the retrain's

name: write_score_edit
requirement_78b: Part 1 sections 3.7 and 14 (A1 per family; L1's edit from the family's scan); Mac, $0

scorer_output.rule: scores = an object {training row id: finite float64} over exactly the prepared set's training rows, high = remove; costs = GPU-seconds by stage (SPEC section 1 item 5); provenance names the scorer's code and settings by SHA-256

datashield.conditional: built before wave 1 only if plan usage allows (U2; FOCUS 9 Oct item (9)); else post-Gate-B exploratory
datashield.edit_name: stage-1 DataShield-style: remove the 600 training rows with the largest CSS
datashield.rule: remove the 600 rows with the largest DataShield-style CSS over all training rows (global); ties by the sealed rank of registry key datashield.ties

l1.edit_name: stage-1 L1 (LARF-style): remove the 600 training rows with the largest L1 score
l1.rule: remove the 600 rows with the largest L1 score cos(r, r_unsafe) - cos(r, r_safe) at (index l_s + 1, read (a)) over all training rows (global); ties by the sealed rank of registry key l1.ties

selfinf_n.conditional: built before wave 1 only if plan usage allows (U2; FOCUS 9 Oct item (9)); else post-Gate-B exploratory
selfinf_n.edit_name: stage-1 Self-Inf-N-style: the 600 training rows with the largest score (scored only: rank tables and the Jaccard matrix)
selfinf_n.rule: the 600 rows with the largest Self-Inf-N-style score ln(SI + 1) + ln(len + 1) over all training rows (global); ties by the sealed rank of registry key selfinf_n.ties
